A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same A2I study. Their text, equations, six tables, twelve figures, and complete Appendices A–D support reliable comparison after accounting for repagination.

before.justification: v1 reports original text and graph rationalization experiments, attack-success measurements, and Llama prompting and fine-tuning evaluations, including appendix results.

after.justification: v4 retains these original experimental outcomes in Section 5 and Appendices B and D, including A2I performance and attack analyses.

M1.justification: The attacker, generator, predictor, alternating optimization, and uniform-target instruction loss remain unchanged. Equations (6)–(11) and the implementation procedure in Appendix A.3 match.

E1.justification: Both evaluate the same three BeerAdvocate aspects, three HotelReview aspects, BA2Motifs, and GOODMotif. The added discussion of other XAI applications introduces no evaluated datasets, tasks, or scenarios.

E2.justification: Comparator membership matches within every corresponding experiment: RNP, InterRAT, NIR, and FR in the text comparisons; RNP and FR for graphs; RNP, A2R, CR, and FR with BERT; and Llama in Appendix D. Newly cited methods are not added to the evaluations.

E3.justification: The dataset splits and counts, sparsity settings, metrics, architectures, and training settings match. Appendix D retains the same two-shot and supervised fine-tuning procedures, unconstrained Llama rationale length, and output processing.

E4.justification: Both retain the full-text versus random-pattern controls, attacks with and without the instruction loss, additional sparsity analyses in Appendix B, and Llama output case studies in Figures 11–12.

E5.justification: Both specify seed 12252018 for text experiments and averages over five seeds for graph experiments, with standard deviations in Table 3. No uncertainty-reporting practice or statistical testing procedure changes.

E6.justification: Numerical results in Tables 1–4 and 6, plotted accuracy and attack-success curves, and qualitative output examples match. For example, Table 1 retains Beer-Appearance F1 of 57.8 for RNP+A2I at approximately 10% sparsity.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, Assumption 4.1, and Equations (1)–(23) are retained. Appendix C preserves the attacker-existence argument, convergence derivation, and entropy/cross-entropy relationship without substantive revision.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same claims about generator-induced spurious correlations, attack-based inspection and instruction, and effectiveness across text and graph tasks. The claim of competitive rationale quality against Llama also remains unchanged.

C2.justification: The Impact Statement expands the prospective applications discussion from rationale-based data cleaning and fairness/security to jailbreak detection, backdoor detection, robotics, and other modalities. The interpretations of experimental results, mixed-sentiment analysis, and Llama comparison qualifications remain unchanged.

D1.justification: The new Acknowledgements identify Huazhong University of Science and Technology's HPC platform as the computation site. Existing implementation details, hyperparameters, GPU specifications, and data-access instructions remain unchanged; adding https to the same repository address does not change code access.

R1.justification: v4 adds further rationalization references, briefly describes Liu et al. (2025)'s use of final-layer representation norms, and adds XAI and multimodal references in the Impact Statement and Appendix A.1. The additions broaden context without substantively revising the novelty argument or positioning against previous causal methods.

P1.justification: v4 replaces the template running header with the paper title, renames Broader Impact to Impact Statement, expands that passage, and adds Acknowledgements. Other wording changes are localized, with the main narrative and appendix organization retained.

P2.justification: All six tables and twelve figures retain their content and design. Figure 4 moves within page 4 with different surrounding text wrapping, and equations, paragraphs, and references reflow within the retained two-column layout.

improvement.justification: The scientific content and evidence remain unchanged. v4 adds useful references and corrects the template header, but its expanded Impact Statement introduces the stray sentence 'The attachments are the new reference letters' and poorly explained citation links, such as citing Yang et al. (2025) for backdoor detection while listing a title about graph distribution shifts. These localized clarity and citation-precision problems modestly outweigh the editorial gains.
